description: Browse a corpus: the provision files under a corpus or folder (for example united-states/federal/usc/title-11), with headings, as in force on a date. For a folder of acts or instruments, by_folder gives one row each with its title and last change; a partial name lists the folders that start with it (malta/national/acts/sl/586. for every instrument made under Cap. 586).

by_folder.description: One row per sub-folder (an act or instrument) with its title and last change.

date.description: An in-force date, YYYY-MM-DD, or "today". Defaults to today.

max_results.description: At most this many (of folders, at most 100) (default 200, at most 2000).

offset.description: Rows to skip: the next_offset the answer before gave in "page" (default 0).

path.description: A corpus, a folder inside one, or the start of a folder name.

name: list_provisions
title: List provisions
